title: Bonyas ben Bonyas
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 85b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.85b.19): he came before Rabbi, who said to them, “Make room for a hundred-year-old man.” Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yose said to him: “Rabbi, this man’s father has a thousand ships at sea and correspondingly a thousand towns on land.” Rabbi said to him: “When you reach this man’s father, tell him not to send him before me in these garments.” Hyman reports “ben Nannas” in the Arukh under סבן and a reading in Rashi that he was Rabbi’s student. In [Eruvin 83a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.83a.6): “When Rav Dimi came, he said: Bonyos sent Rabbi a modius of kondeis from Na’usa”; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads ben Bonyas. In [Gittin 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.59a.17), Bonyas ben Bonyas sent Rabbi precious linen garments, and [Rashi on Gittin](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Gittin.59a.17.1) describes him as a wealthy Jew.[^1]

notes.text: Eruvin 85b gives “a man worth a hundred maneh.” It introduces a second visitor, worth two hundred maneh, before the exchange about his father’s ships, towns and clothing in [Eruvin 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.86a.1). [Rashi on Eruvin](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.85b.19.1) describes a wealthy man who lent houses and kept furnishings in them. The consulted Gittin calls the sender Bunyim ben Nunyim. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=725&lang=en) cites the gifts and the measure of kondeis.
